name: Hajdúszoboszló (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over white with a narrow black border, charged at the centre with the town arms of Hajdúszoboszló: a blue and green shield with a figure, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hajdúszoboszló arms with helm, crest and mantling
